item.title: AI in Cybersecurity: Beyond the Hype
item.description: AI in Cybersecurity: Beyond the Hype Artificial intelligence is transforming cybersecurity — but not always in the ways vendors promise. What AI Actually Does Well Pattern recognition — finding anomalies in massive datasets Speed — analyzing threats faster than human analysts Scale — monitoring thousands of endpoints simultaneously Consistency — never gets tired, never misses a shift Where AI Falls Short Context — understanding business impact and risk Creativity — anticipating novel attack techniques Explanation — black-box models don’t explain their reasoning Adversarial robustness — AI systems can be fooled The Real Opportunity The best security operations combine human expertise with AI augmentation:

item.title: Welcome to Project AI
item.description: Welcome to Project AI We’re launching our platform for AI-powered information security. This is where cybersecurity meets artificial intelligence. What You’ll Find Here Threat research — analysis of emerging attack techniques AI security — protecting ML systems from adversaries Automation guides — practical SOAR and SOC automation Tool reviews — open source security tools we use and build The Mission Security teams are overwhelmed. Alerts pile up, threats evolve faster than humans can respond, and skilled analysts are scarce. AI isn’t a silver bullet — but it’s a force multiplier.
